decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Y210-01_Rev02, Y210-02_Rev02, Y210-03_Rev02, Y210-04_Rev02, Y210-05_Rev02, Y210-06_Rev02, Y210-07_Rev02, Y210-08_Rev02, Y210-09_Rev02, U21-01, U21-05, TQRQM24275155529869Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning

Unless otherwise specified in the application the materials to be used for the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted along with work of making good shall be carried out in materials to match those of the existing building.Reason: To ensure that the appearance of the development respects the appearance, existing materials and built and natural features of the surrounding area.

Prior to occupation, details of refuse storage facilities including facilities for the recycling of waste to be provided within the development, in accordance with the Enfield Councils Waste and Recycling Planning Storage Guidance should be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The facilities shall be provided in accordance with the approved details before the development is occupied or use commences.Reason: In the interests of amenity and the recycling of waste materials in support of the Boroughs waste reduction targets.

Prior to occupation, details of the following should be submitted to and approved in writing by the LPA:-	Facilities for 1 secure cycle parking spaces within the site for staff-	2no. of publicly accessible Sheffield cycle standThe development shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details.Reason: To ensure the provision of cycle parking spaces in line with the Council's adopted standards.

The premises shall only be open for business between the hours of 08:00-23:00 (Mon to Sat) and 09:00-22:00 on Sunday (including bank holidays). Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the occupiers of adjoining and nearby residential properties.

The ground floor unit shall only be used as a coffee shop as described in the application and shall not be used for any other use that falls within sui generis in the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended). Reason: To ensure that the use remains appropriate to the local centre to safeguard the vitality and viability of the centre, to prevent the clustering and siting of hot food takeaways in proximity to a school, and to protect the amenity of neighbouring occupiers, in accordance with Policies DMD 25, DMD 26, DMD 32 of the Enfield Development Management Document and Policy E9 of the London Plan.

The sale and consumption of food and drink, including alcohol, shall be restricted to customers seated within the premises. No food or drink shall be consumed outside the building/approved winter garden or in any external area associated with the site unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.Reason: To safeguard the amenity of the occupiers of adjoining premises and protect the general environment.

Before the building hereby permitted is first occupied the proposed glazing in the southern elevation facing No.773 Hertford Road shall be glazed with obscure glass only and shall be permanently retained as such thereafter. Reason: To safeguard the privacy and amenities of occupiers of adjoining residential properties.
